slug: 2024-08-15 Mauritania Launches Digital ID for e-Services, Built on TECH5 Platform (Houwiyeti)

facts.fact: ID Tech Wire reports a TECH5/SmartMS/UNDP pilot for MTNIMA, demonstrated in March 2023, in which a citizen matches an e-passport or ID card by selfie, stores a digital ID on the phone and uses biometric login to the government e-services portal, leading to the Houwiyeti app launched in 2024.
facts.system: Government e-services portal (biometric login with digital ID)

systems.platform: TECH5 biometric SDKs; SmartMS back-end and identity provider
